2025.summary: The class focuses on Jesus washing his disciples' feet during the Last Supper, emphasizing Jesus' love for his disciples and his impending departure to be with the Father. It explores the significance of Jesus' actions and the disciples' reactions, highlighting themes of humility and devotion.

2026.summary: The class discusses Jesus' warning about the betrayer in John 13, emphasizing the grief and significance of the moment. It also covers Jesus' command to love one another as He has loved them, highlighting the depth and sacrificial nature of this love.

2027.summary: The class discusses Jesus as the true vine and God as the farmer, emphasizing the importance of producing fruit and abiding in Christ. It also covers the significance of unity and love within the ecclesia, drawing parallels between the vine and the body of Christ.

2028.summary: The class discusses Jesus' promise of the Holy Spirit in John 14, emphasizing the natural inclination to keep God's commandments when one loves Him. It highlights the importance of addressing God as 'our Father' in prayer and the spiritual discernment Christadelphians possess.

2029.summary: The class explores Jesus' prayer in John 17, emphasizing his confidence in God and his mission to glorify the Father. It highlights Jesus' role as the second Adam and the ultimate destiny of believers to be like God, stressing the importance of faith and discipleship.
